text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm Mejiro Dober. Nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …I want to be a strong racer—a racer strong enough to run with total confidence at all times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Okay, I want to be a strong racer—a racer strong enough to run with total confidence at all times.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …That's about it. So… let's both do our best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I need you to push me really hard, Trainer, okay? I'll do my best, too… so I can keep up during lessons.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
